from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow figures from one company's 10-Q report for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to, as named")
    period_start: str | None = Field(description="The start date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM format")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, in YYYY-MM format")
    net_cash_used_in_investing_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash used in investing activities (capital expenditure approximation); negative value indicates outflow")
    net_cash_used_in_investing_activities_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of investing activities: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    net_cash_from_financing_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities; positive indicates proceeds raised, negative indicates outflow")
    net_cash_from_financing_activities_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of financing activities: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    quote_investing: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing investing activities figure")
    quote_financing: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing financing activities figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
